Item Class: Misc Map Items
Rarity: Currency
Inscribed Ultimatum
--------
Challenge: Protect the Altar
Area Level: 83
Requires Sacrifice: The Siren x4
Reward: Doubles sacrificed Divination Cards
--------
Choking Miasma III
(A large and fast cloud that deals Chaos Damage over Time will follow you)
Blistering Cold III
(Many frozen pustules will periodically appear, chill you, and rapidly explode when you approach)
Reduced Recovery
(60% Reduced Life, Mana, and Energy Shield Recovery Rate)
Lethal Rare Monsters
(Rare Monsters have 2 additional Modifiers)
Overwhelming Monsters
(Monster Hits Overwhelm all Physical Damage Reduction)
10% increased Monster Damage
30% more Monster Life
--------
Can be used in a personal map device to open portals to the Trialmaster's Domain and attempt his challenge. Portals will close once the challenge begins. While viewing your Atlas, Right-click this item to pinpoint its location.
